title: Mixed Event — Awakening Beat — Episode1 Four As One

meta.Event Outline: Kohane has steadily built up experience, including performing solo at events. An, Akito and Toya all acknowledge her efforts, but Kohane herself doesn't seem confident. An and the others try to get Kohane to believe in herself.

rows.Line: Live House

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: And the winner is... Vivid BAD SQUAD!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Yeah! Way to go, Vivid BAD SQUAD!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: They just keep getting better... Battling against Arata probably gave them a huge boost too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: There were so many other good teams today, but I'm glad we pulled through in the end.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! But we did it, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Still, there's a lot we need to work on. We're doing a debrief right after this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree. Some things are still bothering me as well.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then let's head over to my place!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm home!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Hey, you're back.
Based on your mood, I'm guessing your event went well?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, it went perfectly!
Everybody else was really good too, so we learned a lot.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
That's great.
And the usual for you guys, I'm guessing?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yes. Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Then let's begin our debrief.
About our first song...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That leaves the finale for our third song. It felt as if the audience cheering speeds up our tempo more than we'd like...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I totally get what you mean. It's like they're making us follow their rhythm instead of our own...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And we gotta stick to our own rhythm if we want to sound as good as we possibly can.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I have a habit of rushing ahead during the second half too, so I'll make sure to keep practicing!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, maybe I can work on that while I practice the song I'll be doing for that solo event that's coming up...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The same habit sort of applies to that song too...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Mind if we talk a little more about that?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Sure, what is it?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane, you've been participating in all these solo events to get more on-stage experience, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. I've been learning so much, and I think they're really helping me stay much calmer during our shows compared to before.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You've even learned how to become quite the crowd-pleaser. I have to say, it's very impressive.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I know, right? I feel the same way.
That's why...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Instead of doing events by yourself, Kohane, why don't we use that time to practice more as a team or enter into more team events?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm with her. You've got plenty of experience already, so it's probably good to start working more as a team now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: See what I mean?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, okay...
...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's just that... I'm a little worried...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You're worried?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. I've gotten used to performing on stage, but my singing still isn't at your guys' level yet. That's why I'm wondering if it's okay for me to just stop like this...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Kohane, you're such a modest girl.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You keep saying, I'm not up to your guys' level yet. But I think you already are.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So you don't need to worry so much!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh...
Thanks, An.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: In her case, this might be the right way to go...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I think so too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, then we can start practicing more as a team...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's keep kicking butt, together!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But is it okay if I still sing in next week's event? I sort of already promised that I'd go...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Of course!
Oh, mind if we come and watch...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I still haven't gotten a chance to see you on stage, Kohane. I really wanna see how you do up there and stuff, you know?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Are you sure? Knowing that you're in the crowd...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Girl, you'll be fine!
Show us what you're really made of!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We'll all be there rooting for you!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We...?
All of us are going?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Well, duh.
We oughta be there to see the results of all of her hard work.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'd like to go too.
Singing and performing is important, but we may also be able to learn something from watching.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Fine, whatever...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: On one condition, Kohane. Give it everything you've got.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I... I will!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm a little nervous, but I'll do my best to make it a good show...!
Kohane's Room

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No! I did it again there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
One more time!
Focus...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay. That sounded much better...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (If I can sing like this, then I should be okay for next week's event.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (An even said that I'm singing as well as everyone else is now, so I'm sure everything will be fine...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Hehe. I feel like I'm dreaming. I never imagined myself being told that I'd rise up to their level considering how good they already were...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Am I really singing as well as they say I am...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I know I've made improvements here and there, but I'm still not sure about being able to sing that well...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (No, now's not the time for that...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I need to keep practicing while I still can...)
